inspiration_ideas: She turns her torso a bit further into the golden light while keeping her hips squared, fingers now gently pinching the sky-blue bikini strap as if testing its stretch, and she offers a slow flirty half-smile with one eyebrow softly arched.

Shifting her weight onto one leg so her hip pops harder, she lets her free hand drift down to toy with the button of her micro denim shorts while her other fingers stay near the cleavage, locking heavier bedroom eyes on the lens with lips softly parted.

She draws both hands up to frame the underside of her full bust, lightly pressing the fabric for more tension and rounded shape, tilting her chin down for a coy upward glance through long lashes with a teasing bitten-lip smirk.

Stepping half a pace closer through the wildflowers, she reaches back to gather a thick section of her long dark hair and pulls it forward over one shoulder, giving a warm sultry stare with half-lidded eyes and a barely-there knowing smile.

Arching her lower back just enough to push her chest forward, she trails one fingertip slowly along the upper edge of the bikini cup while the other hand rests on her opposite hip, catching her lower lip between her teeth again but with a hungrier, more intense expression.

She twists her shoulders into a gentle three-quarter angle so the rim light kisses her collarbone and the side of her breast, fingertips still grazing the deep cleavage line, and she softens into a dreamy heavy-lidded gaze with lips gently open as if mid-breath.

Letting one strap slip slightly off her shoulder for added wardrobe tension, she cups the side of her breast with an open palm while looking straight ahead, flashing a playful mischievous grin that shows a hint of teeth and crinkles the corners of her eyes.

She brings her free hand up to lightly touch her own collarbone and then slide down toward the bikini top, body still in the soft waist twist, fixing the camera with direct smoldering bedroom eyes and a slow sensual lick of her lower lip.

Rising onto the balls of her feet for a taller, more confident stance amid the tall grass, she hooks both thumbs into the front waistband of her tiny denim shorts and pulls just enough to create tension, delivering a soft inviting smile that turns into a flirty wink.

She angles her head slightly away then glances back over the raised shoulder with hair cascading across her face, one hand still resting possessively along the cleavage while the other brushes a strand aside, holding a charged half-lidded stare with lips softly pressed together in quiet heat.
